content.short: Shell Protocol is a wrapping protocol and a DeFi development toolkit.
content.description: Founded in 2019 by the Cowri Labs team, Shell Protocol is a DeFi protocol that enables cross-chain interaction through token wrapping. Users can wrap tokens on one chain or protocol and swap them for assets on another. In addition to its wrapping mechanism, Shell Protocol provides an open-source SDK that lets developers build complex decentralized applications without writing extensive boilerplate code.
content.meta: Shell Protocol is a DeFi protocol that facilitates multi-chain interaction. Discover Shell Protocol and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
